paragraphs: The elders of Pumbedita: Rav Yehudah and Rav Eina, Sanhedrin 17b. They taught creation and asked Rav Yosef to teach them the chariot, Ḥagigah 13a. In connection with Rava, Pesaḥim 117b; Eruvin 79b–80a.
